faq_heading: Homes near David Brankin Elementary: your questions answered

faq.q: Are the homes on this page in the David Brankin Elementary catchment?
faq.a: Not necessarily. The search finds homes whose listing names the school, and the sold prices are measured by distance. Surrey School District sets the catchment and shows it on a map only on its website, so confirm the exact address with the district before you offer.

faq.q: How does the David Brankin Elementary home search find homes?
faq.a: It lists active homes whose listing text names David Brankin Elementary, so a nearby home that leaves the name out will not show.

faq.q: How much do homes near David Brankin Elementary sell for?
faq.a: Within 1 km of the school, 42 homes sold between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026. Medians were houses $1,245,000, townhomes $638,000. A median is the middle price and is shown where at least 5 homes sold.

faq.q: How fast do homes sell near David Brankin Elementary?
faq.a: Within 1 km of David Brankin Elementary the median was 34 days on the market, closing at 95.9% of the list price, with 10% of sales above the list price for the 42 homes within 1 km.

faq.q: Which schools are closest to David Brankin Elementary?
faq.a: In a straight line, the closest schools in the provincial list are Senator Reid Elementary (0.6 km north-west), Betty Huff Elementary (0.6 km north-east) and Continuing Ed SD36 (Invergarry) (0.8 km south).

Below are the homes currently for sale whose listing mentions David Brankin Elementary, followed by what homes within 1 km of the school sold for.
How the David Brankin Elementary search works

MLS® listings are not tagged by school. This search finds houses, townhomes and condos whose description names David Brankin Elementary, so a home close to the school whose listing leaves the name out will not appear, and a listing that names the school can sit farther than 1 km away. Use the sold prices below for the distance-based picture, and ask Jared to watch for homes near the school that the search misses.

Between November 1, 2025 and October 31, 2026, 42 homes sold within 1 km of David Brankin Elementary: 21 houses and 19 townhomes. The largest group was houses, at a median of $1,245,000.

blocks.text: Schools within 3 km of David Brankin Elementary

30 schools in the provincial school list sit within 3 km of David Brankin Elementary in a straight line (17 elementary, 11 secondary, 2 other; 3 independent). The closest is Senator Reid Elementary, 0.6 km away, and the farthest on this list is Surrey Academy of Innovative Learning, 2.6 km away. By type, the nearest secondary school is Continuing Ed SD36 (Invergarry) (0.8 km); the nearest independent school is Sikh Academy (1.3 km); the nearest school listing a French Immersion program is Simon Cunningham Elementary (2.5 km). Other elementary schools close by: Senator Reid Elementary (0.6 km north-west), Betty Huff Elementary (0.6 km north-east), Kirkbride Elementary (1.3 km west), Cindrich Elementary (1.3 km east), Cedar Hills Elementary (1.5 km north-west). The nearest school teaching the same grades (K-7) is Senator Reid Elementary, 0.6 km north-west of David Brankin Elementary.
